verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs show a single agent deployed across live chat/messenger, email, Slack (communities and Connect channels), WhatsApp, SMS and voice, which covers most of the story. Social channels are never named, and in-app support is only implied by the messenger. missing for 10: explicit social-media channel support (e.g., Facebook/Instagram/X), explicit in-app channel documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-channel deployment.

support.subject: As a support leader, one agent covers chat, email, and in-app, plus the channels my customers actually use — Slack, WhatsApp, social

citations.quote: Handles tickets, cases, emails, live chat, WhatsApp, SMS, and more
Fin for Slack supports your customers directly in Slack communities and dedicated Connect channels, resolving questions instantly with replies that stay threaded and feel native to Slack.
Fin over Email resolves everything from simple FAQs to complex threads with attachments and multiple recipients
Fin for messenger brings the highest-performing AI Agent for customer service to live chat
